verification_report.summary: The statement is self-contained and the proof is correct. The base case is valid; the descending column operations preserve the determinant and use unchanged source columns; expansion along the first row and extraction of the row factors are valid; the remaining minor is exactly the Vandermonde determinant on x_2,\ldots,x_n; and the induction hypothesis gives the required product over all pairs. The proof contains no prohibited justification, unsupported premise, internal fact citation, or external reference.
